tool.name: any_routes
tool.description: Build a routing view from Markdown descriptions under a directory: folders are represented by their README.md (its description, when present). Use before exploring an unfamiliar Markdown knowledge base to pick a folder route. Route lines are always workspace-root-relative full paths (e.g. `explorer/sandbox-containment/containment.md`), never relative to the selected route root, and are sorted case-insensitively by route path. Every line is either a Markdown file route (with ` | description` when the file has one) or a depth-truncated folder rendered as `[truncated: N] folder-path` (with ` | description` when the folder's README has one), where N is the folder's recursive .md count (the total that would expand on descent). `routeCount` counts route entries (files plus truncated folders), not raw .md files or structural tree nodes. Returns route paths and descriptions, never file content.

routePath.description: Optional folder route to scan from. "." scans from the root. Use slash-separated folder paths such as Topics, handbooks, or explorer/dsh-plugin-dev; do not pass a Markdown file route.

depth.description: Maximum directory depth to expand below the route root (routePath if given, otherwise the workspace root). Depth is measured from that route root, not the workspace root. A folder sitting exactly at the depth boundary is not descended into and is shown as `[truncated: N] folder-path` instead of expanding. Defaults to 0: lists only the route root's own Markdown files plus each direct sub-folder as its `[truncated: N]` representative.

format.description: Output shape. `flat` (default) returns one route line per entry. `tree` returns nested nodes with the same semantics: a file node has its full `.md` path in `path` and `kind: file`; a truncated folder has `path`, `kind: folder`, `truncated: true`, `omittedMarkdownCount` (the recursive .md total), and `markdown` (its README path); an expanded folder has only `path` and `children`.

excludeDirs.description: Directory names skipped during traversal. Defaults to the plugin config.

excludeDotEntries.description: Whether to skip dot entries (names starting with ".") such as .github or .agents. Defaults to true.

maxFiles.description: Maximum Markdown files to read. Defaults to plugin config maxFiles.

respectGitignore.description: Whether to skip paths ignored by .gitignore files during traversal. Defaults to true.
